name: Form.io MCP Server
description: Gives AI coding agents governed access to forms, roles, actions, and project templates in a self-hosted Form.io Enterprise deployment through the open-source @formio/mcp server.

skills.name: Form Management
skills.description: Creates, fetches, lists, and updates form definitions, with draft, publish, and revert on revision-licensed deployments.

skills.name: Role Management
skills.description: Creates, lists, and updates project roles.

skills.name: Form Actions
skills.description: Lists action types and attaches, updates, or removes actions such as email, webhooks, and role assignment.

skills.name: Project Templates
skills.description: Exports a project's roles, resources, forms, and actions as JSON and imports templates additively.
